programmes.d: With Boston in lockdown after the bombing at the city's famous marathon, an epic gun battle erupts between police and the two men who are soon revealed to be the bombers.
When gang warfare overwhelms a small town, FBI agent James Gagliano hatches a plan to dismantle the rival gangs in one day.
When an outlaw biker gang brings drugs and violence to Taunton, Massachusetts, it's time for the FBI to step in. Will the undercover agents make the big bust or will their cover get blown?

When an armed bank robber terrorizes the Boston area, the FBI's Bank Robbery Task Force springs into action. Can law enforcement catch up to the Southside Bandit before someone gets seriously hurt or worse?
The FBI investigates two New York police officers who are suspected of commiting murders for the mafia.
A devastating explosion rips through the heart of downtown Oklahoma City, forcing FBI investigators to conduct a rescue mission while searching for clues about the murderer.
After Timothy McVeigh is discovered to be responsible for the bombing of a Federal Building in Oklahoma, the FBI learns his hope is to instigate a civil war in America.
An infamous serial killer and rapist eludes investigators in California for decades. The FBI and local law enforcement resort to new techniques in order to finally bring the killer to justice.
A soldier's New Year's Eve turns into a nightmare when another soldier tries to kill him.
A young girl is turned into a sexual slave for a self-proclaimed prophet. An idealistic young man is brainwashed by a dangerous and racist cult.
Story of the Hong Kong native and former Marine who, along with his friend Leonard Lake, was responsible for a grisly series of crimes.

The controversial case of Native-American activist Leonard Peltier, who is serving consecutive life sentences for the murder of two FBI agents in 1975 at the Pine Ridge Indian Reservation near Oglala, South Dakota.
Conor McInnerney stopped breathing while breastfeeding and was rushed to the hospital in 1998. Eugene Turner, a doctor on the case, was charged with murder after a nurse saw him smother the child.
The bizarre story of Michael Pardue, an Alabama man who was imprisoned on three murder charges and who escaped from prison three times and was recaptured.

The notorious case of Kenneth McDuff, the most infamous sexual predator in Texas history, who was sent to death row for three murders, released because of prison overcrowding, and then raped and killed two more women.
The story of how an enterprising reporter, a private investigator, and federal authorities unraveled the mystery behind the 1995 disappearance of the founder of the American Atheist organization.

In 1849, a man suddenly disappeared in Bermondsey. The discovery that he had been brutally murdered enraptured the press and the public. Even Charles Dickens was totally engrossed in the story of the sinister Marie Manning.
At the time of Jack The Ripper, London was home to some of the most terrible individuals the city has ever seen. One of the very worst was the elusive Borough Poisoner, George Chapman.
Having killed his wife and buried her in the basement, Dr Crippen believed he had escaped on a ship to Canada. But the police managed to hunt him down and bring him to account for his terrible crime.
George Smith had many aliases. He needed them for his many wives who he would soon murder in order to claim the inheritance. Catching this chameleon would be a gargantuan challenge.
Edith Thompson and Frederick Bywaters were in love. But the young couple were convicted for murdering her husband in a case that shocked society and fascinated Alfred Hitchcoc
It was WWII and London was rocked by the Blitz from the planes flying above. But down on the streets below another terrible danger lurked in the shadows. A serial killer was on the loose.
As Europe recovered from the damage of WWII, soldiers made their way home from the front line. But one man, brought back all the savagery and brutality of the fighting.
John Christie brought death to everyone around him. He managed to pin his terrible crimes on another man who would be sentenced to death. He eluded capture for years.

On a hot summers day in 1934, a horrifying discovery was made in the trunk at the luggage office of Brighton Train Station. Two days later, a similar case was found.
As police investigated the disappearance of wealthy widow, Olive Durand Deacon, in early 1949, they could not have imagined the gruesome confession told to them.
In the summer of 1953, the world watched Queen Elizabeth II crowned. The day before the coronation the body of a teenage girl was found floating in the River Thames.
Ruth Ellis was the last woman to be hanged in Great Britain. Her act of murder divided the nation.
A 21-year-old California man is suspected of hiring a hitman to kill his parents and sister in order to gain financial control of the family's estate.

"It's one of the strangest cases in FBI history. A Pennsylvania pizza delivery driver claims he was delivering an order when a group of men attacked him, put a bomb on him and forced him to rob a bank. Is he an innocent hostage or a co-conspirator? "

Three weeks after the bombing death of Pennsylvania pizza delivery driver Brian Wells, a man tells investigators that there's a dead body in his freezer, right next to the location where Brian delivered pizzas just before he robbed the bank.

Annie Le, a brilliant Yale PhD student, vanishes days before her wedding. CCTV cameras catch Le entering her research lab but there's no trace of her leaving. The FBI uncovers a dark secret that exposes the shocking truth behind her disappearance.
